views.name: admin_analytics_daily_dimensions
views.definition:
SELECT date,
    dimension,
    value,
    page_views,
    unique_sessions,
    project_views,
    post_views,
    whatsapp_clicks,
    email_clicks,
    email_copies,
    github_clicks,
    linkedin_clicks,
    demo_clicks,
    cv_downloads,
    contact_submits,
    article_shares
   FROM private.analytics_daily_dimensions;

views.name: admin_analytics_daily_sessions
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    date,
    session_hash,
    content_type,
    content_id
   FROM private.analytics_daily_sessions;

views.name: public_contact_settings
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    email,
    whatsapp_number,
    whatsapp_default_message,
    cta_title,
    cta_description,
    form_enabled,
    cv_enabled,
    email_visible,
    whatsapp_visible,
    whatsapp_cta_label
   FROM private.read_public_contact() read_public_contact(id, email, whatsapp_number, whatsapp_default_message, cta_title, cta_description, form_enabled, cv_enabled, email_visible, whatsapp_visible, whatsapp_cta_label);

views.name: public_media_assets
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    public_url,
    filename,
    mime_type,
    file_size,
    width,
    height,
    alt_text,
    caption,
    category,
    visibility
   FROM private.read_public_media() read_public_media(id, public_url, filename, mime_type, file_size, width, height, alt_text, caption, category, visibility);
